verdict.rationale: INPI Portugal is a government industrial-property office offering patent, trademark and design filing services, not an AI agent or assistant. Acting as an MCP client that consumes tools from plugged-in servers is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any agent or MCP-client capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
